semantics: Refactor candidates that were investigated, costed and refused, as data rather than prose (.agents/docs/proposed/process/2026-09-20-agent-refactorability-gates.md section 2). Each candidate carries an `id`, the `symbols` that carry its shape, and a `ruling` anchor holding the evidence. Two enforcement points, because a pure-tier suite has no PR body. (1) src/test-kernel/architecture/refutedCandidatesRatchet.vitest.ts pins every symbol's `signature` — the declaration with its bodies elided as `{…}`, comments stripped, whitespace collapsed — so a symbol that changes shape fails until the baseline is updated in the same PR. (2) .github/workflows/refuted-candidates.yml fails a pull request whose diff touches a refuted symbol's declaration unless the PR body cites that candidate's `id`. Neither gate forbids the change: they require the author to have read the ruling and to say so. Re-proposing a refused candidate as originally specified is the failure this exists to stop; landing a candidate on NEW evidence is legal, and that PR cites the id, states what changed, and deletes or rewrites the entry.
